'''Aldazar''' is the horse owned by [[Furyk Karede]]. He is a bay horse. His name means "eagle" in the [[Old Tongue]].

==Activites==
Aldazar carries Furyk throughout his search for [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]].{{ref/book|10|4}}{{ref/book|11|34}}{{ref/book|11|36}}
